variants.headline: Still in view: party leader faces a challenge
variants.sub: A challenge to the leadership of {party} has opened.
variants.body:
The leader of {party} is being challenged. Coverage continues after {months_running} months; this is a continuing story rather than a fresh announcement.

An argument over leadership deserves workers' attention when it concerns whose needs a party represents. Working people's needs belong at the centre of this discussion, rather than outside its political argument.
